credits.title: A Wonderful Time
credits.overview: In the late 1940s, a romantic evening takes a suspenseful turn when a young couple is confronted with a mysterious danger, leading them to make a life-altering decision that transcends time and reality.

credits.title: Paper Tiger
credits.overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

credits.title: Paperweight
credits.overview: Bill Walker faces a life-changing decision when he receives his draft card for the Vietnam War. Torn between his father's patriotic expectations and his mother's fear for his life, Bill must choose whether to answer the call or disregard.
